# VAR-PLAN-0008: No plannable HTTP path

- Severity: warning
- Area: PLAN

## Description

An Ingress serves only spec.defaultBackend, or a rule has no HTTP path, so varco can plan no case for it.

## Remediation

Add an HTTP path with a backend, or probe the default backend manually.
